references.title: INSTAT — Albania Population and Housing Census 2023: Main Results
references.scope: Printed pages 16 (Albanian) and 114 (English), section 2.1.1, give resident totals 2,821,977 in 2011 and 2,402,113 in 2023. These are published census counts; the article does not apply the separate post-enumeration coverage adjustment or substitute annual population estimates.
references.access: Full PDF retrieved and relevant text verified with web reader on 18 October 2026; a subsequent repeat fetch timed out, without invalidating the successful initial retrieval.

references.title: INSTAT — The population of Albania
references.scope: Primary statistical-literacy explanation: lower fertility/emigration underlie population decline; natural change equals births minus deaths; net migration equals immigration minus emigration. Resident population differs from nationality and diaspora size.

calculations.name: Change in published census resident population

calculations.name: Percentage decline from 2011 census

meaningEvidence: Original local 71.285-second video mapped to public TikTok ID through native publish verification. Reviewed captions were based on local ASR and original visible subtitles; article uses corroborated meaning, not uncertain exact particles.

Visual inspection of dynamic final review, captioned frame at 27 seconds and original caption contact sheet at 63–71 seconds: young woman, DUMA Podcast watermark, interview shot/reverse shot and Albanian captions.

Speaker identifies herself as 22; discusses departure/depopulation and institutional neglect, quotes brother’s wish to come protect her, asks for support/solutions rather than personalities, and names universities, hospitals and violence.
Native published caption broadens theme to family distance, prejudice/racism and starting again; those are Eduard’s accompanying framing, not all spoken claims by guest.
limitations: Guest identity, original recording date and full interview context are unverified. No name, profession, protest affiliation, political party or specific violent incident is inferred.
Repost date is not presented as original interview date. The guest’s family experience is not attributed to Eduard.
The universal-sounding phrase nobody wants to leave is treated as an emotional appeal, not population survey evidence.
Closing source caption appears Asnjë where reviewed caption has Asgjë; the article avoids a verbatim quote of that uncertain line.
The clip is not independent proof about every Albanian hospital/university or a specific alleged incident.
